Name: Fix Those Beds!
Author: SpringsSong
Description:
If you get this mod from anywhere other that ModDrop, the Chucklefish forums, or my Github, it was STOLEN!

If you've ever used a recolor that uses two differing colors or patterns for the single bed and the double bed, you were doubtless surprised when you next visited Pierre's or Robin's and saw that their nice double beds - which otherwise look fine if the recolors match - were, in fact, the two halves of the single bed sandwiching the middle of the double bed! This small map patch mod seeks to rectify that.

Recolors featured in screenshots: A Toned Down Stardew Valley, Yellog's Dark Brown and Cream Furniture

Downloads.Description: Adds update keys for Github and Chucklefish

Manifest.Name: Fix Those Beds!
Manifest.Description: A small map patch mod to fix the double beds in Robin's and Pierre's using tiles from both the double and single beds.
